messages:
zara: Noticed a negative provisional in console for acct 601 after a stream retry + toolcall during canary. small impact but CS flagged it. :grimacing:
liam: Any trace ids or short logs?
zara: trace ses_X7Pq; excerpt below (sanitized):
```
router.INFO: session=ses_X7Pq route=us-east-1 -> fallback=eu-west-3 reconnect=true prefetch=true
sidecar.DEBUG: prefetch_toolcall_id=ptc_71 present
router.DEBUG: outbound_headers: X-Toolcall-Idempotency: (absent)
ledger.INFO: session=ses_X7Pq provisional:+24 toolcall=ptc_71 truncated=true
ledger.INFO: session=ses_X7Pq reconcile_adjust:-40 reason=dedupe-merge
ui.DEBUG: provisional_before=+24 provisional_after=-16
```
chao: Looks like fallback path rebuilt headers and dropped the prefetch id, target region made a second confirmed toolcall, ledger later reconciled by subtracting 40 -> net negative shown.
liam: Internals can go negative during reconciliation but we must not show negatives to customers. Server-side should clamp usage API responses to 0 and include an audit flag explaining the correction.
avery: UI plan: display 0 for provisional and surface a compact banner "Billing correction applied during routed retry" linking to audit entry. will add hover text.
chao: Root fix: router must copy session-side prefetch id into outbound idempotency header on any fallback/reconnect path. I'll add code to preserve prefetch_toolcall_id -> X-Toolcall-Idempotency and add unit+integration tests.
zara: SRE repro in bug PLAT-4890: steps to reproduce included.
liam: I'll push a small hotfix to clamp API values and emit metric billing.reconcile.negative_count with tags {canary,region}. ETA ~90m for canary.
ops-bot: Alert: provisional_negative_detected account=601 value=-16 canary=canary-2026-09 tags=[prefetch fallback]
audit-bot: Audit event created: acct=601 event=billing_correction reason=dedupe-merge trace=ses_X7Pq id=EV-9876
avery: once liam exposes the audit id, I'll wire the banner link.
chao: Router patch ETA 6h for code+tests; will run in next canary. conservative forwarding only when prefetch=true to avoid header leakage.
liam: Adding server-side clamp and audit flag now. Also logging reconcile_reason so CS can filter incidents.
zara: owners assigned in PLAT-4890: liam (ledger), chao (router), avery (console), zara (reporter/SRE).
ops-bot: Canary paused: canary-2026-09 paused at 2026-09-14T11:22Z pending fixes.
zara: Thanks everyone. Closing thread; followups in PLAT-4890 and PRs. Ping me for full traces if needed.
